import numpy as np
def analyze(i):
    d=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    H,W=d.shape
    cnt={int(c):len(np.where(d==c)[0]) for c in np.unique(d)}
    print('pair',i,'shape',d.shape,'->',o.shape,'counts',cnt)
    # marker color = exactly 4 cells
    m=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4]
    assert len(m)==1, m
    mc=m[0]
    ys,xs=np.where(d==mc)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
    print('marker',mc,'bbox',r0,r1,c0,c1)
    sub=d[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
    # key cells outside box
    outs=[(int(yy),int(xx),int(d[yy][xx])) for yy in range(r0,r1+1) for xx in range(c0,c1+1) if False]+[(int(yy),int(xx),int(d[yy][xx])) for yy in range(H) for xx in range(W) if d[yy][xx]!=mc and not (r0<=yy<=r1 and c0<=xx<=c1)]
    print('key cells outside:',outs)
    # interior comps
    inter=[]
    seen=set()
    for yy in range(r0,r1+1):
        for xx in range(c0,c1+1):
            if d[yy][xx]!=mc and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                st=[(yy,xx)];comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        p,q=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=p<H and 0<=q<W and d[p][q]==d[a][b]: st.append((p,q))
                v=d[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
                rs=[p[0] for p in comp];cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                inter.append((v,len(comp),(min(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs))))
    print('interior comps:',inter)
    print('output:')
    for row in o: print(''.join(map(str,row)))
for i in (1,2,3): analyze(i)

    allblks.sort(key=lambda t:t[0])
    for _,c in allblks:

    # straightforward placement: for each color, assign slot -> position; new block placed left/right of anchor depending on slot
    def slotpos(slot,ref):
        dy,dx=slot

    for cv,pos in list(slots.items()):
        c=None

            c['rel']=pos

                    yy2,xx2=yy+dr,xx+dc

        else:

import numpy as np, collections, json
def comps_of(g,bg):
    H,W=g.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); res=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if g[y,x]!=bg and not seen[y,x]:
                col=int(g[y,x]); q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=True; cs=[]
                while q:
                    yy,xx=q.pop(); cs.append((yy,xx))
                    for dy,dx_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx_
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny,nx]==col:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[p[0] for p in cs]; xs=[p[1] for p in cs]
                res.append(dict(color=col,h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1,w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1,
                                top=min(ys),left=min(xs),cells=set(cs)))
    return res

def f(gin):
    g=np.array(gin); H,W=g.shape
    cnt=collections.Counter(g.flatten().tolist())
    mark=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4][0]; bg=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    ys,xs=np.where(g==mark); r0,r1,c0,c1=int(ys.min()),int(ys.max()),int(xs.min()),int(xs.max())
    sub=g[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]; hh,ww=sub.shape
    info={}  # color -> list of comps (each comp = set of cells in original coords)
    vis=np.zeros_like(g,dtype=bool)
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            v=int(g[y,x])
            if v in (bg,mark) or vis[y,x]: continue
            st=[(y,x)]; comp=set()
            while st:

# Compare input vs output blocks: find what happens to each object (translation)
def objs(gi,bg,mark):
    vis=np.zeros_like(gi,dtype=bool); res=[]
    for y in range(gi.shape[0]):
        for x in range(gi.shape[1]):
            v=int(gi[y,x])
            if v in (bg,mark) or vis[y,x]: continue
            q=[(y,x)]; cs=set()
            while q:

import numpy as np, json, os, re
def comps(a):
    h,w=a.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if a[i,j]!=5 and not seen[i,j]:
                col=a[i,j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; cs=[]
                while st:
                    p,q=st.pop(); cs.append((p,q))
                    for dp,dq in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=p+dp,q+dq
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and a[x,y]==col and not seen[x,y]:
                            seen[x,y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                rs=[c[0] for c in cs]; cc=[c[1] for c in cs]
                out.append((col,len(cs),min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)))
    return out
